pricing.title: Service & Pricing
pricing.subtitle: All costs at OneClick are transparent: Item cost + International shipping + Optional value-added services. The first two align with the buying and forwarding stages, and value-added services are always optional.
pricing.stage1Desc: Item price + China domestic shipping + agent fee
pricing.stage2Desc: Calculated by weight / line / destination in real time
pricing.stage3Desc: All services are optional and charged on demand

fee.common: Common agent (Taobao / Tmall / JD / PDD, etc.)
fee.commonNote: No service fee, only item price and domestic shipping
fee.secondhandNote: Due to extra communication, charged on item value. Min ¥10, max ¥20
fee.otherNote: Charged on item value, final rate shown at checkout

s1.intro: All costs before the item arrives at OneClick warehouse. Three parts:
s1.item1Desc: Retail price on Taobao / Tmall / JD. No extra markup.
s1.item2Desc: Paid to the Chinese seller. We pay on your behalf, no extra handling fee. Free for seller-paid shipping.
s1.item3Desc: Our service fee for purchasing the item on your behalf, depends on source platform and value.
s1.exampleDesc: A ¥100 T-shirt on Taobao + ¥10 domestic shipping + ¥0 service fee + ¥3 detailed photos = ¥113 for Stage 1.
s1.storageDesc: Items enjoy 90 days free storage after arrival. Afterwards ¥0.5/day. Max 180 days; unclaimed items will be treated as abandoned. Use the Extended Storage value-added service if needed.

s2.intro: Charged when you submit a waybill. Calculated in real time by outbound weight / line / destination:
s2.firstDesc: Base fee for the first billing unit (e.g. 500g).
s2.extraDesc: Additional fee per extra unit above the first unit.
s2.clearanceDesc: Duty / VAT collected by the destination customs, paid by recipient.
s2.fuelDesc: Extra percentage on top of base freight against oil price fluctuation.
s2.opDesc: Warehouse handling fee (storage / sorting / packing, etc.).
s2.exampleDesc: Sending a 1000g parcel via HK UPS Economy line ~ ¥428 = first 500g + extra 500g + clearance + fuel + op. Use Quick Quote for real-time estimation.

s3.intro: Value-added services are optional and charged on demand. Nothing is billed without your active confirmation. No hidden fees.
s3.tip: Final fee is calculated by the system in real time. Common services can be checked in one click when submitting a waybill.

faq.q1: Is OneClick pricing transparent? Any hidden fees?
faq.a1: Fully transparent. All fees are shown before you place an order. No hidden fees.
faq.q2: How is the agent service fee charged? Is common agent free?
faq.a2: Based on the source platform. Common agent on Taobao / Tmall / JD / PDD is completely free. Secondhand platforms charge 5%~10% (min ¥10, max ¥20).
faq.q3: Are value-added services mandatory? What are they?
faq.a3: All optional. We provide QC, photos, reinforced packaging, insurance, etc. You pick on demand and are only charged after confirmation.
faq.q4: How to see my order fee details?
faq.a4: Order detail page shows the full breakdown, including item price, service fee and shipping.
faq.a5: Pre-charged when you submit the waybill based on estimated weight / line / destination. Final amount follows the carrier's official bill, with refund balance.
